sources.last_excerpt:
2027 application dates

"> 2027 application dates Applications to study at UNSW Sydney across all 2027 terms are now open. We encourage students who are interested in studying with us to apply early for their best chance to secure a place. Applicants are strongly encouraged to submit their applications and all required supporting documentation as early as possible to allow sufficient time for assessment. While we will make every effort to provide an admission outcome within the relevant offer timeframe, this cannot be guaranteed for applications submitted after the standard deadline or where outstanding documentation is provided late. Applications for both undergraduate and postgraduate programs Undergraduate and postgraduate coursework applications are accepted on an ongoing basis in accordance with Term application dates outlined below and offers are released on a rolling basis* (see below for indicative application processing times).
